headline: Stocks to watch today: Meesho, Manappuram Finance, EIH, and others
hook: Upcoming trading session focus list announced

modes.bear: Inclusion on morning lists offers no fundamental catalyst and can invite speculative volatility.
modes.bull: Curated watchlists highlight active retail attention and potential volume spikes for listed counters.
modes.simple: A daily list highlights specific companies that traders might watch closely during the market session.

summary: Moneycontrol has released its daily curated list of stocks to watch for the upcoming trading session. The watchlist includes prominent names such as Meesho, Manappuram Finance, EIH, TD Power Systems, NMDC Steel, Dilip Buildcon, and Ola. Retail investors often track these morning compilation lists to identify potential intraday or short-term momentum opportunities. Such stock lists help traders quickly spot active market participants before the opening bell.
whats_next: Market opening bell and subsequent price action for listed stocks.
why_it_matters: Daily stock watchlists highlight active equities for potential short-term trading.

headline: EIH Q2 net profit rises 19 percent with new Hyderabad hotel plan
hook: Strong travel demand lifts EIH margins

modes.bear: A ₹777 crore capital outlay for the new Hyderabad project increases execution risk and capital intensity in the medium term.
modes.bull: Net profit up nearly 20% alongside margin expansion and a major capital expenditure plan shows strong operational momentum for EIH.
modes.simple: EIH, the company behind Oberoi and Trident hotels, made more money this quarter as revenue and profit both grew. They also plan to spend ₹777 crore building a new hotel near the Hyderabad airport.

summary: EIH reported a 19.3% year-on-year increase in Q2 FY27 net profit to ₹136 crore, driven by revenue growth of 16.1% to ₹694 crore. EBITDA rose 22.7% to ₹189 crore, while operating margins improved to 27.2%. The board also approved an investment of ₹777 crore to build a Trident Hotel near the Hyderabad Airport. For retail investors, the earnings demonstrate robust hospitality demand translating into bottom-line expansion for listed hotel operators.
whats_next: Next quarterly earnings announcement in January 2027
why_it_matters: Higher hotel earnings signal strong domestic travel and leisure spending.

headline: EIH Limited releases its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
hook: September quarter financial results submitted to exchange

modes.bear: Rising operating costs might have compressed profit margins for the hotel operator.
modes.bull: Strong hospitality demand during the quarter could reflect positively on EIH's revenue growth.
modes.simple: EIH Limited has officially reported its financial performance for the last quarter. Shareholders can now check how much profit or loss the hotel company made during this period.

summary: EIH Limited has formally submitted its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges following a board meeting. The filing provides the company's financial performance metrics for the second quarter of the fiscal year. Retail investors holding EIH shares can review the reported revenue, profit margins, and operational performance to assess the company's current financial health.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data dictates near-term stock price movement for EIH.
